topic: Apparent Movement of Sun, Moon, and Stars
key_concepts: The Sun appears to move across the sky during the day.
The Sun is low near the horizon in the early morning and high in the sky at noon.
The Sun appears to move upward from morning to noon and downward from noon to late afterno
The Moon appears to move across the sky at night.
The Full Moon is low near the horizon in the early evening and high in the sky at midnight
Stars appear to move across the sky at night.
A constellation is a group of stars that forms a pattern or shape.
The Big Dipper and Orion are star patterns whose positions change during the night.
The Sun, Moon, and stars appear to move across the sky in similar ways.
Shadows change size and position during the day because the Sun's position changes.
Observing a stick's shadow can record the Sun's apparent movement without looking directly
